description:

title: Framework Administrator
description:
Framework Administrator

Contract: 12-month fixed-term contract

The Role

We are looking for a Framework Administrator to provide proactive, high-level support to legal departments, taking ownership of key client frameworks and helping to deliver an exceptional level of service.

Reporting to the Framework Manager, you will play a central role in managing allocated frameworks, associated client accounts and service levels. You will work closely with the framework team, fee earners, central teams and external clients to ensure internal and external client expectations are consistently exceeded.

Key Responsibilities
- Review Framework Agreements to identify and document client-specific protocols and processes.
- Implement guidance and training for support teams and monitor ongoing compliance.
- Manage and submit regular management information (MI) reports.
- Coordinate responses across multiple departments and produce reports assessing service levels and performance against KPIs.
- Analyse and interpret complex data, including contract documentation.
- Support the management of revenue for key clients and assist with the billing process.
- Provide high-level revenue updates, including processing rebates where required.
- Support the coordination of client audits.
- Use IT systems to generate reports, formatting and editing information as required.
- Produce accurate, professional documentation and client communications to the highest standard.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with internal teams and external clients.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, service delivery and efficiency.

Person SpecificationWhat We're Looking For
- Ability to analyse and interpret complex data, including contract documentation.
- Experience of using IT systems to generate reports, with the ability to format and edit information as required.
- Strong MS Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Excellent organisational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
- An aptitude for producing documents and client communications of the highest standard.
- Ability to use initiative, anticipate requirements and take ownership of tasks.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with multiple teams.
- A commitment to delivering high-quality, efficient and professional service.

What We Offer

The role offers a flexible and hybrid working environment, alongside a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits may include private medical insurance, pension contributions, an employee assistance programme, wellbeing initiatives and enhanced parental leave.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Assistant Accountant

Nottingham Up to £30,000 Permanent Full Time Office Based

SF Partners is currently recruiting for an Assistant Accountant to join a well-established and growing business based at its Head Office in Nottingham.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid accounting experience who is looking to continue developing within a supportive finance team. The role offers broad exposure across the finance function, working closely with the Management Accountant and Financial Controller, with plenty of opportunity to build on your existing experience.

The role

As Assistant Accountant, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance function and take responsibility for a varied range of duties, including:
- Managing stock and expense-related balance sheet processes
- Processing expenses and company credit card transactions
- Supporting supplier statement reconciliations and aged payable reviews
- Assisting with ledger cleansing and intercompany journals
- Posting to the general ledger and cashbook
- Completing bank reconciliations across multiple companies
- Supporting balance sheet reconciliations
- Providing cover across Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable when required
- Assisting with finance projects and ad hoc tasks for the Management Accountant and Financial Controller
- Supporting the implementation of new systems, technology and process improvements

About you

My client is looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience within an accounts or finance department
- A good understanding of double entry bookkeeping and accounting principles
- Strong reconciliation skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good time management and the ability to prioritise effectively
- A proactive and self-sufficient approach
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- A positive attitude and willingness to continue developing

A fully qualified AAT candidate would be particularly well suited, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.

If you are an experienced accounts professional looking for a broad Assistant Accountant role with genuine development opportunities, please apply for immediate consideration.

title: Part-Time Finance Assistant
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Finance Assistant

Nottingham Hybrid Temp-to-Perm Approx. 3 Days Per Week (Flexi-Hours)

Macildowie are delighted to be partnering exclusively with a growing luxury travel consultancy who create bespoke, once-in-a-lifetime travel experiences for ultra-high-net-worth clients across the world.

We're looking for an experienced Finance Assistant to support the day-to-day finance function as the business enters an exciting period of growth.

This is a predominantly remote role, with the ideal candidate based around Nottingham to allow for occasional collaborative working days.

The role

You'll work closely with the Finance lead, taking ownership of transactional finance and bookkeeping responsibilities including:
- Bank reconciliations
- Xero reconciliations
- Attaching invoices and receipts
- Raising customer invoices
- Processing payments
- General bookkeeping and finance administration
- Chasing missing supplier invoices where required

Transaction volumes are relatively modest compared with larger corporate environments, although workload naturally increases during live luxury travel projects.

What we're looking for

We're keen to speak with people who have:
- Previous Accounts Assistant or Bookkeeping experience
- Strong practical experience using Xero
- Confidence completing bank reconciliations independently
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Experience working remotely or managing their own workload
- A proactive, self-starting approach

Travel industry experience isn't required, although it would certainly be a bonus.

What's on offer?
- Approximately 3 days per week (flexibly worked)
- Predominantly remote (1 Day per week in an office/co-working space)
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- Friendly, collaborative small business environment
- Opportunity to grow alongside an expanding international consultancy

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a flexible role where you can genuinely make an impact within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist /Admin
description: We are looking for a friendly, caring and organised Receptionist to join our welcoming GP practice team. As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play a vital role in providing a professional, compassionate and efficient service, helping patients to access the right care and support. This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a busy environment and takes pride in making a positive difference to patients experiences. You will work alongside a supportive multidisciplinary team and will receive the training and guidance needed to develop your skills and confidence within primary care. The successful candidate will provide a friendly, professional and efficient reception service to patients, acting as the first point of contact for the practice. Main duties will include answering telephone calls and enquiries, booking and managing appointments, registering patients, processing prescriptions and requests, updating patient records, and signposting patients to appropriate services. You will also support the wider practice team with general administrative duties, ensure information is handled confidentially and accurately, and help maintain a high standard of patient care and service at all times. The role requires excellent communication and organisational skills, a calm approach in a busy environment, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team. Welcome and assist patients and visitors in a professional, courteous and compassionate manner. Answer telephone calls promptly and deal with enquiries appropriately, maintaining a calm and helpful approach at all times. Book, amend and cancel appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Signpost patients to appropriate healthcare professionals, services and organisations where required. Process prescription requests and other patient enquiries accurately and efficiently. Register new patients and maintain accurate and up-to-date patient information. Ensure patient records and information are handled accurately and confidentially, in line with practice policies and information governance requirements. Receive and process administrative requests, messages and correspondence. Liaise effectively with GPs, nurses, healthcare professionals and the wider practice team. Support the practice with general administrative duties, including filing, scanning, photocopying and data entry. Assist with the smooth running of reception and waiting areas, ensuring patients receive a positive experience. Deal appropriately with sensitive or difficult situations, escalating concerns to the appropriate member of staff when necessary. Maintain a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times. Follow practice policies, procedures and protocols, including those relating to safeguarding, infection prevention and health and safety. Attend staff meetings, training and development sessions as required. Undertake any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role and level of responsibility.
